title: Binance Adds HFT, OCEAN on Cross Margin and HFT on Isolated Margin
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance has added  HFT  and  OCEAN  as new borrowable assets on  Cross   Margin ,   and  HFT  as a new borrowable asset   on  Isolated Margin .   Trading is opened for the following new margin pairs: New Cross Margin Pairs:   GRT/BUSD ,  HFT/BUSD ,  HFT/USDT ,  OCEAN/BUSD ,  OCEAN/USDT New Isolated Margin Pairs:   HFT/BUSD ,  HFT/USDT Explore Binance Margin Now! Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits and rates. Further information: What Is Margin Trading How to Short on Margin Trading How to Long on Margin Trading Thanks for your support!
